'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female [[NPC]] researcher who can be found at the entrance way of [[Startorch Academy]] at night, talking with '''Halvad'''. 

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Petrova:''' Mr. Halvad, does the Antivoid Canopy work by using cultivated [[Exostrider]] coating cells to resist Void Storms?
:'''Halvad:''' Yes, it all starts with isolating the cells from the Exostrider. We then guide and differentiate them into a massive protective mesh. That's the triumph of Phase-Coating Sciences.
:'''Halvad:''' On the Exostrider's own surface, these cells maintain a dynamic equilibrium. They resist contamination and regenerate continuously.
:'''Halvad:''' However, the Antivoid Canopy still can't perfectly replicate that trait. Once wear sets in, we must manually apply newly cultivated coating cells.
:'''Petrova:''' So we're still a long way from the original's... perfection.
:'''Halvad:''' But with our intellect and technology, we'll get there one day.
----
;After completing {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:'''Petrova''': Senior, did you see this section of the data?
:'''Halvad:''' Is this... when the Antivoid Canopy was running at critical load? The readings actually went above zero!
:'''Petrova:''' Does that mean the coating cells temporarily gained the same properties as Exostrider material?
:'''Halvad:''' That spike... was it because of the Exostrider? But at the time, it was still in Voidspace. Nowhere near Lahai-Roi.
:'''Halvad:''' And before that interval, the Canopy never behaved like this.
:'''Petrova:''' Could it be... that Professor Mornye's "Drive Replica" gave the Exostrider a new ability? A way to sense anything connected to it?
:'''Halvad:''' Perception that can pass through the Stridergate... How would that even work? A new form of Resonance? Huh. A hypothesis worth digging into...
{{Dialogue End}}
